question:
X is the son of Y, who is the brother of Z.

How is X related to Z?
solution:
**Family Chart :**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d38b746f2eed9ecdf5b14a58d695aa637f1f00487f5a14bec01bfd03743fcd39.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/308defbcd6d0b637ddff7ee805b1341818fb1d0bd3138c435e2aa88d0b0be7c3.png]
